Pretzel rods with the tips dipped in melted dark chocolate, set on baking paper in groups of five, a pinch of flaky salt on each.
M: Slow cooked beef chuck chilli with chipotle, cumin and cocoa
Beef chuck diced and browned, onion, garlic, chipotle, cumin and cocoa, tomato and beans, braised 3 hours at 160C until thick. Sour cream and cheddar.
saucy beef mince with onion, capsicum and tomato in toasted brioche, melted cheddar and pickles

Saucy beef mince cooked down with onion, capsicum, tomato and brown sugar, piled into toasted brioche buns with melted cheddar and crunchy pickles. Brown 700g beef mince with 1 diced onion and 1 diced green capsicum for 10 minutes. Stir in 250ml tomato sauce, 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp American mustard and 125ml water. Simmer 15 to 20 minutes until thick. Toast 4 brioche buns, lay a slice of cheddar on each base, pile on the mince and top with sliced dill pickles. Serve with plenty of napkins.
W: Red and green stripes, like the top that locks them in
Vanilla cupcakes baked at 175C for 18 minutes, piped with buttercream striped red and green in the piping bag so it swirls.
K: Nancy lives on caffeine now, plunger brew in big mugs
Coffee made in a plunger, 60g ground coffee to a litre, steeped 4 minutes, served black in big mugs.

s.note: Sour cream and cream cheese dip blended with parsley, chives and garlic
s.how: Blitz 200g sour cream, 100g cream cheese, 1 garlic clove, the juice of half a lemon, a big handful of parsley and a bunch of chives until green and smooth. Season with salt and chill 30 minutes. Serve with 300g kettle chips.

s.note: rods with tips dipped in dark chocolate, set in fives on baking paper with flaky salt
s.how: Melt 150g dark chocolate in short bursts. Dip the tips of 20 pretzel rods, lay them on baking paper in groups of five like fingers and sprinkle each tip with a pinch of sea salt flakes. Leave 20 minutes to set.

m.note: Slow cooked beef chuck chilli with chipotle, cumin and cocoa
m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches. Soften 2 diced brown onions and 3 garlic cloves, add 2 tbsp chipotle in adobo, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tbsp cocoa, 800g crushed tomatoes, a 400g tin kidney beans and the beef. Cover and braise at 160C for 3 hours until thick. Serve topped with 150g sour cream and 100g grated cheddar.

w.note: Red and green stripes, like the top that locks them in
w.how: Beat 125g soft butter with 150g caster sugar, add 2 eggs, then fold in 200g self-raising flour and 100ml milk. Spoon into 12 cases and bake at 175C for 18 minutes. Beat 150g butter with 300g icing sugar, split in two and colour one red and one green. Spoon both side by side into one piping bag and pipe swirls.

d.note: Nancy lives on caffeine now, plunger brew in big mugs
d.how: Put 60g ground coffee in a large plunger, pour over 1 litre of just-off-the-boil water and steep 4 minutes. Plunge and pour into four big mugs. Serve black, with 100ml milk on the side for anyone who isn't trying to stay awake.
